title: Space
subtitle: Autumn 1 · 6-week overview
summary: Settling in through space-themed play: building relationships with key adults and peers, growing confidence in group activities and exploring new environments and whole-body sensory experiences.
intentions: Build relationships with key adults and peers
Explore new environments with interest (Autumn walk outing)
Experiment with whole body in sensory experiences
books: Zoom to the Moon by Pat-A-Cake
Where’s Mr Astronaut by Ingela Arrhenius
songs: 5 Little Men in a Flying Saucer
Zoom Zoom We’re Going to the Moon

events.label: National Read a Book Day: Invite parents to bring their child’s favourite book from home.
National Recycling Week: Read recycling book at circle time.
Autumn Walk: First signs of the season, collect items for real life Autumn tray.
Black History Month: Read My First Heroes at circle time.

days.title: Space playdough with tools
days.what: Make homemade playdough, adding black paint and silver glitter. Allow the children to explore the playdough using the tools provided.

days.title: ‘5 Little Men in a Flying Saucer’
days.what: Sing at circle time with enthusiasm.

days.title: Space Star Printing
days.what: Provide card, paint and star-shaped cookie cutters. Encourage the children to dip the star into the paint and print it onto their card.

days.title: Space Toys
days.what: Provide the small world space toys and tent and allow the children to explore.

days.title: ‘Zoom to the Moon’ by Pat-A-Cake
days.what: Read at circle time with enthusiasm.

days.title: Exploring Moon (kinetic) Sand
days.what: Provide moon sand for the children with tools and allow them to explore.

days.title: Space Dance Party
days.what: Turn on the disco light, the space light, play some space themed music and encourage the children to dance!

days.title: Painting Toilet Rolls for Telescopes
days.what: Provide some toilet rolls and paint. Allow the children to decorate their toilet roll. Encourage them to look through them like telescopes.

days.title: Space Dress Up
days.what: Provide some space dressing up resources and encourage the children to attempt to put some things on independently.

days.title: ‘Where’s Mr Astronaut’ by Ingela Arrhenius
days.what: Read at circle time with enthusiasm.

days.title: Space Cornflour Play
days.what: Mix up some cornflour gloop with some food colouring and glitter, adding some space figures. Allow the children to explore using their hands and tools.

days.title: Counting Aliens/Astronauts (Emptying and Filling)
days.what: Provide the buckets, bangles and aliens and astronauts from pre-school. Encourage the children to empty and fill, counting how many they have.

days.title: Making Tin Foil Stars
days.what: Cut black card into star shapes and provide tin foil and glue. Help the children to put glue on the card and place some foil on top.

days.title: Space Rocket Pretend Play
days.what: Set up the room like a rocket; put the baby gym in the middle of the room and cover it with an emergency blanket. Add the light up pebbles and play some space sounds from Alexa.

days.title: ‘8 Little Planets’ by Chris Ferrie
days.what: Sing at circle time with enthusiasm.
